name: Pundi AI uninitialized swap proxy takeover
summary: Pundi AI deployed its swap proxy with empty initialization data, leaving initialize(address,address) callable by anyone. Twelve seconds later the attacker initialized the proxy, became its owner, and used the original UUPS implementation to install attacker code. That retained authority later minted one million unbacked PUNDIAI.

loss.notes: Ethereum token-transfer receipts reconstruct 22.550224439317992269 WETH and 23,427.2875 USDT received from monetization, less 10 USDT supplied by the attacker in the same campaign. The resulting $90,467.78 is an exact Ethereum-only loss; it excludes recovered or locked tokens and additional BSC proceeds from the official approximately $260,000 cross-chain total.

ageReset.description: The proxy creation transaction selected implementation 0xd1393ea0d5f0641274e0084302cea3884b356069 but supplied empty initialization data. Its public initializer remained reachable until the attacker called it in the next block.

sources.note: Reviewed the proxy deployment, takeover and mint traces; all Upgraded events and implementation-slot values from deployment through the mint; historical initializer calls; and the attacker's Ethereum token-transfer receipts. Pundi AI deployer 0x0f413055adef9b61e9507928c6856f438d690882 created proxy 0xb5a58db25eedefeede888f55d6157e13d4b4f4f8 at block 21892110:152 with implementation 0xd1393ea0d5f0641274e0084302cea3884b356069 and empty initialization data. Upgraded(address) log 635 records that activation, and the implementation runtime hashes to 0x22f114d9442a9030054a3a6fad08d0e7ea5a19c9012d5276838c51ebe7902a4f in both the deployment and takeover blocks. At the deployment block owner() returned zero, and a historical eth_call from unrelated address 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 successfully called initialize(address,address) with arbitrary recipients. Twelve seconds later attacker transaction 0xec62e8b1c9f47c73825cab1c680c18cf27c41b66c77433aa5ae178455187336a entered helper 0xb6f3c830d289db8d12c5e15b8d558539d0efd83a, called the proxy's initializer through the original implementation, assigned ownership to the helper, and then called the original UUPS upgradeToAndCall path to select attacker implementation 0x916ff94ad30bdf0559c7f858f7fe3e437fd11a08. The receipt's later Upgraded event naming the original implementation was spoofed by the attacker code: the EIP-1967 slot contains 0x916ff94ad30bdf0559c7f858f7fe3e437fd11a08 immediately after the transaction and through the July mint. Transaction 0xd54ed7443aaf0d256aefe1797c32487e1ea5200c3d38b7a47ab02019caad0c56 later entered that attacker implementation and made PUNDIAI 0x075f23b9cdfce2cc0ca466f4ee6cb4bd29d83bef mint 999999.999999999983222784 tokens to 0x26bc046bfa81ff9f38d0c701d456bfdf34b7f69c. The curve therefore ages the victim's unprotected initializer to the first takeover; the attacker implementation is later loss machinery. Ethereum receipts from block 22901217 through 22904448 show the attacker received 22.550224439317992269 WETH and 23,427.2875 USDT from monetization and supplied 10 USDT, for net proceeds of 22.550224439317992269 WETH plus 23,417.2875 USDT. Source 6 unwraps the exact WETH aggregate, and source 7 transfers the exact net USDT aggregate. Chainlink ETH/USD feed 0x5f4ec3df9cbd43714fe2740f5e3616155c5b8419 returned 297338490000 with 8 decimals and updatedAt 1752314507 at block 22902399.

limitations: The exact loss covers Ethereum-realized proceeds only; the official post-mortem's approximately $260,000 cross-chain total also includes BSC proceeds.
